title: High-Voltage Optocoupler Amplifier for Electrostatic Actuators
summary: Many electrostatic actuators require multi-kilovolt drive voltages at sub-milliamp currents, a task poorly suited for conventional switching devices. As an alternative, we demonstrate a high-voltage amplifier using optocouplers as active elements. The amplifier produces a 20-kV peak-to-peak output with up to 500 Hz bandwidth while maintaining a minimal component count.
